highlights.description: A dependency-free Go model for describing which entities and fields an application stores and how each is classified, with validation and a query-guard predicate

added.description: Catalog, entity and field model: visibility (`public` or `internal`), independent `pii` and `secret` tags, erasure strategy, export flag, subject key, privacy scope, hold applicability, versioning and retention note

`Validate` reports every problem at once, with rule identifiers: explicit visibility, `secret` implies `internal`, subject key required and known, erasure required for personal data in privacy scope, retain reason required, unique names
Audience filtering (`VisibleTo`, `VisibleFields`) and default-deny query predicates (`AllowedInQuery`) that always block internal and secret fields and block personal data unless allowed
JSON load and save with stable ordering, `Merge` that reports conflicting entity definitions, and a Markdown renderer for documentation
JSON Schema generated from the Go types and embedded, with a test that fails when the committed schema drifts
Guides: model and validation reference, and erasure strategies
